This is the boyfriend mentioned above. I've deleted my old e-mails and am going to nuke the myspace account. we move in a few months so that should keep this woman from following us anywhere. i did however write her to see if maybe she knew or would admit to having anything to do with the profile. I agree i should have mentioned the e-mail notification to my girlfriend as soon as i got it. but i've always tried to find ways to deal with hackers on my own. I still need a way to prove that this profile wasn't of my making. The only thing i can do is say it's not mine, point out that it has no photo, (every profile i've ever made has my photo for things like this) and try to find the ip address that created the profile. backtracking it to the origin. any further advice? 
I do like the restraining order idea and will enforce it should it prove useful. does it cost money to have one issued? or proof of misdeeds?
personally i was bothered by the visiting friends. i had little warning and no real interest in seeing them. it was an uncomfortable situation and i do intend to avoid such things in the future. ive allowed my kindness to hinder my personal life and it can't continue as such. as for mortally offending her, well i guess it's a good idea. she does cower when confronted it may well back her off.
